text: Amaterasu gave the mirror, the jewels and the sword to her grandson Ninigi, but the man who would build a country with them had not yet been born.
spoken: Ah-mah-teh-rah-soo gave the mirror, the jewels and the sword to her grandson Nee-nee-gee, but the man who would build a country with them had not yet been born.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
